sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 749)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Penny Singleton & Arthur Lake in suburban domestic mishaps on *Blondie* for Camel Cigarettes, young Lee Aaker at Fort Apache on *The Adventures of Rin-Tin-Tin* for Nabisco, two golden editions of *The Carnation Contented Hour* for Carnation Evaporated Milk (Percy Faith's anniversary overtures in 1939 and Buddy Clark singing Broadway hits in 1949), Mercedes McCambridge on *Abie's Irish Rose* for Drene, and Dick Powell previewing *Romeo and Juliet* on *Hollywood Hotel* for Campbell's, Penny Singleton (1939), Lee Aaker (1955), Percy Faith (1939), Buddy Clark (1949), Mercedes McCambridge (1943), and Dick Powell (1936–1955):
